liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Broken Arrow** (1 review): Phil contributed a moving performance of Broken Arrow during the show [11]
- **Wave To The Wind** (1 review): Reviewer notes Jerry successfully apprehended all chord changes in this song [6]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Notable moment includes the Playin' Reprise intro leading into the Playing in the Band verses [9]
- **Uncle John's Band** (1 review): Great free-fall space moment transitions into Uncle John's Band [9]
- **Days Between** (1 review): Days Between is described as beautiful in any show, featuring so many roads [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **crowd/tuing**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-08-27.140283.fob.Schoeps-MK41.miller.sirmick.flac.1648** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 173 min [1]
- **gd1993-08-27.147630.dsbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 19 songs; 171 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: The drums and space section is described as awesome, hypnotic, and well worth listening to [13]
- **gd1993-08-27.145798.aud.williams.bandrofcheck.flac16f**: audience recording; 19 songs; 172 min [3]. Said about its sound: Tape flips and dead spots were crossfaded using Sound Forge 5.0 [3]
- **gd93-08-27.sbd.wiley.9486.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 155 min; rated 2.71/5 by 7 [5]. Said about its sound: Jerry's voice is described as playing up a bit throughout the performance [6]

## Around the show

- Weir briefly played chords for Uncle John's Band after Drums, possibly forgetting it was played [6]
- The band cranked it up starting with Playing In The Band [7]
- The band was in a jamming mood, stretching everything a bit without being over-the-top [9]
- The sky over the peninsula was crystal clear with a bright atmosphere that night [11]
- The listener remembers nothing specific about this show thirty-one years later [14]
- Listener rates this as the least favorite of the Shoreline run, suggesting nights 1 and 2 [7]
- The show is noted as fizzling here and there, not a complete performance [13]
- The Shoreline run peaked on the first night and gradually slid from there [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-08-27.140283.fob.Schoeps-MK41.miller.sirmick.flac.1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source: (FOB) Schoeps MK41 > Panasonic SV-255 > dat(48k); Transfer: dat > Sony PCM-R500 > Tascam DA-3000> wav 16/48; Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6… [1]. Also: Charlie Miller provided the source and did the transfer for this recording; The whole of I Fought The Law was patched from shnid 94275 [1]
- **gd1993-08-27.147630.dsbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Dat Master (48k) [2]
- **gd1993-08-27.145798.aud.williams.bandrofcheck.flac16f**: taped by Primo Williams; transferred by Charles Bandrofcheck; source: Sony D6 -> MAC > Sony TCM-TE425 (azumth adjed) -> Sound Blaster Audigy 4! > Sound Forge 5.0 > CD Wav -> flac16. [3]
- **gd93-08-27.sbd.wiley.9486.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>CM>CDR [5]
